transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hi Alex. I'm calling about my bill. I think there's a mistake on it related to my internet plan.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly help you with that. I'll just need to verify your account for security. Could I please have your full name and the customer ID found on your bill?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Sure. My name is Linda Smith. The customer ID is CUST-1029.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, Linda. I'm pulling up your account now... Okay, I see you here. For the final step, could you please verify the 4-digit security PIN on the account?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect, that's correct. Thank you for verifying your information. So, you mentioned a concern about your bill and your internet plan?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes. About two weeks ago, I called to upgrade my internet speed. I was on the 100 megabit plan and I upgraded to the 500 megabit one.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, I see. Let me look at the recent changes on your account.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Right. And I just got my new bill, and it's charging me for the more expensive 500 megabit plan, which is fine, except my internet is still running at the old, slow speed. I'm paying for something I'm not getting.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that, Linda. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I can see the order for the upgrade to our Fiber 500 plan was placed on the 14th of this month. Is that correct?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that sounds about right. The 14th.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And I also see the new charge on your latest invoice. I completely understand your frustration. Let's check your connection speed right now to confirm what's happening. Are you near your computer?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, I'm at my desk right now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great. Could you please open a web browser for me, like Chrome or Firefox?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, it's open.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: In the address bar at the top, please type in 'speedtest.net' and press enter.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, speedtest... dot... net. The page is loading now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent. You should see a large button that says 'GO'. Could you please click that for me?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yep, I see it. Clicking now... The needle is moving.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, it will take about 30 seconds to run the test. It will measure both your download and upload speeds. Let me know what the final results are.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, it's finished. It says... 94.6 for download and 10.2 for upload. That's what I was getting before.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for confirming that, Linda. You're absolutely right, that is consistent with the 100 megabit plan, not the 500. I sincerely apologize for this oversight. Let me check the provisioning status on our side. This will just take a moment.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm looking at the technical details of the order now... and... ah. I see the problem.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: What is it?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It appears there was a system synchronization error. The order was processed correctly by our billing department, which is why it appeared on your invoice, but the command to update the speed on the network equipment was not successfully sent. It was stuck in a pending state.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: So I was billed for something that was never even turned on?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is unfortunately correct, and I'm very sorry. The good news is that I can fix this for you right now. First, I will manually push the provisioning command from my side. This will update your service to the correct speed.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, great.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And second, we will absolutely adjust your bill to credit you for the time you've been overcharged. We'll take care of the speed first. I need to resubmit the service change, which might cause your internet to disconnect for a few minutes. Is now a good time to do that?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, now is fine. Just get it fixed, please.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Understood. I am pushing the command now. I'll need to place you on a brief hold for about two minutes while the network switch accepts the change. Is that okay?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that's fine.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for your patience, Linda. Please hold.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, Linda. I've received confirmation that the provisioning command was successfully processed by the system.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay. So is it fixed now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Almost. To ensure your modem picks up the new speed profile, we need to do a quick power cycle. Could you please locate your Cymbal Telecom modem and unplug the power cord from the back of the device?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, hold on, I have to reach behind the desk... It's the black box with the blue lights, right?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's the one. Just unplug the power cable.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay... it's unplugged. All the lights are off.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. We need to leave it unplugged for a full 60 seconds to allow the internal components to fully reset. I'll keep time for us here on my end.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Alright. Waiting.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: While we wait, I can start looking at the billing adjustment. Let's see... your billing cycle starts on the 1st of the month.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that's right.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And the upgrade was on the 14th. Today is the 29th. So that's 15 days where you were billed at the higher rate without receiving the service.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Sounds right.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, it's been about 60 seconds now. You can go ahead and plug the power cord back into your modem.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, plugging it back in... The lights are starting to blink.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent. It will take a few minutes for the modem to fully boot up and establish a connection with our network. You'll see several lights blink, and then they should turn solid.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: The power light is solid green now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good. We're waiting for the 'Downstream', 'Upstream', and 'Online' lights. They usually flash and then turn solid blue or green.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, I see a DS light flashing... now an US light...

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: They're both solid blue now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great. And the 'Online' light? It might look like a little globe.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, the globe is flashing... still flashing... okay, it's solid now. All the lights look good.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Fantastic. That indicates the modem is online with its new configuration. Now for the moment of truth. Could you please go back to speedtest.net on your computer?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: The page is still open. Should I refresh it?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, please refresh the page and then click the 'GO' button one more time.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, refreshed... and clicking GO. Here it goes.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let's see what we get this time.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Whoa... okay, it's much faster. The needle went way over.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's a very good sign.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, the test is done. It says download is... 489.2. And upload is 45.8.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Wonderful! That's exactly where it should be for the Fiber 500 plan. Speeds can fluctuate slightly, but that is a perfect result. I'm so glad we got that sorted out for you.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Wow, what a difference. Thank you. I can already tell web pages are loading faster.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're very welcome. Now, let's address the billing side of this. As we discussed, you were incorrectly billed for 15 days.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, for about half the month.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Exactly. Let me calculate the credit. Your old plan was $49.99 per month, and the new plan is $69.99 per month. The difference is $20.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Right.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So, we need to credit you for the period you paid that extra $20 without the service. A full 30-day month at $20 means the daily difference is about 67 cents.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay...

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So for 15 days, that comes out to a credit of... one moment... $10.05. We'll just round that up to an even $10.50 for the inconvenience.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, that sounds fair. So that will be taken off my next bill?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can apply it as a credit to your account right now, and it will automatically be deducted from your next invoice amount. Would you like me to proceed with that?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, please.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright, I'm submitting the credit request now... Just a moment to get confirmation.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, the system has accepted it. I have a reference number for this credit. It's CR-77419. I've also added detailed notes to your account explaining the system error and the resolution we performed today.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: CR-77419. Got it. Thank you for being so thorough.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Of course. It's my job to make sure this is all clear and resolved for you. Again, I sincerely apologize for the initial error and the trouble you had to go through.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Well, you fixed it, so that's what matters. I appreciate it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm glad to hear that. So, just to recap: we've successfully updated your internet service to the 500 megabit speed you ordered, and we've applied a $10.50 credit to your account for the billing error.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that covers everything. Thank you, Alex.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You are most welcome, Linda. Was there anything else at all I could assist you with today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, that was the only thing. I'm all set.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Wonderful. Well, thank you for your patience while we worked through this. We appreciate your business.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, thanks again for your help.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're welcome. Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom. Have a wonderful rest of your day!

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: You too. Bye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Call ended. Adding final disposition notes to account CUST-1029. Issue: Billing error post-upgrade. Resolution: Manually provisioned service to correct speed, confirmed via user speed test. Applied pro-rated credit of $10.50 via reference CR-77419. Customer satisfied.
